## Run it

1. Put the app on a database with the seed loaded (`npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed`). Set `CRON_SECRET` and `HEALTHCHECK_SECRET` in `.env.local`. Run `npm run dev`.
2. In the Bruno app: **Open Collection** → this folder → environment `local` → set the secret values (`seedPassword` = your `SEED_PASSWORD`, `cronSecret` = `CRON_SECRET`, `healthcheckSecret` = `HEALTHCHECK_SECRET`).
3. Right-click the collection → **Run**. Or headless:

```bash
cd audit-system/audits/turnflow-home/03-bruno && npx @usebruno/cli run --env local
```

Folder order matters: `01-public` must run before `02-auth`, because after login the cookie jar is authenticated.

**Verification status:** all 22 `.bru` files parse with `@usebruno/lang` (`bruToJsonV2`). The collection has **not** been executed against a running app during the audit, because no Neon database was reachable from the audit environment. Expected statuses are taken from the handler code cited in `02-eraser/contracts.md`.

## Coverage map

| Route | Requests | Not covered (needs data the seed doesn't expose over HTTP) |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/health` | 01-public/01 | none |
| `/api/health/deep` | 01-public/02, 03 | `not_configured` (503) needs a server without the secret |
| `/api/auth/*` | 02-auth/01–05 | rate-limit lockout after N failures (PROPOSED: loop the wrong-password request and expect the correct password to also fail, then clear `auth_attempts`) |
| `/api/blob-upload` | 01-public/05, 03-signed-in/03–05 | happy path and 413 (need a real `propertyId`/`requestId` and a >4 MB file) |
| `/api/files` | 01-public/04, 03-signed-in/01–02 | 200 for an owned file (needs a stored blob path) |
| `/api/cron/reminder-digest` | 01-public/06, 07 | none |
| `/api/cron/reset-investor-demo` | 01-public/08 | authorized run (only on a demo database) |

## What Bruno can't test here: the 44 server actions

Every write in TurnFlow is a Next.js Server Action (`lib/actions/*.ts`). Server actions are called by an internal action id that changes between builds, so they aren't a stable HTTP contract and don't belong in Bruno. They need the **authorization matrix** the repo already planned (`docs/06-testing/test-strategy.md:43-64`): run each action as each actor against a real database. That's ticket **Build the server-action authorization matrix** (GAP-BRUNO-01) in `06-plane/tickets.md`.

PROPOSED shape (Vitest, real Postgres; requires a driver that can reach a local or branch database, see GAP-PRISMA-04):

```ts
// __tests__/integration/authorization-matrix.test.ts  (PROPOSED)
const ACTORS = ["owner", "otherOwner", "assignedVendor", "unassignedVendor", "collaborator", "signedOut"] as const;

const MATRIX: Record<string, Partial<Record<(typeof ACTORS)[number], "allow" | "deny">>> = {
  approveQuoteAction:             { owner: "allow", otherOwner: "deny", assignedVendor: "deny", collaborator: "deny", signedOut: "deny" },
  submitVendorBidAction:          { assignedVendor: "allow", unassignedVendor: "deny", owner: "deny", collaborator: "deny" },
  reviewCloseoutSubmissionAction: { owner: "allow", otherOwner: "deny", assignedVendor: "deny" },
  recordRequestPhotoAction:       { owner: "allow", assignedVendor: "allow", unassignedVendor: "deny", collaborator: "deny" },
  createCommentAction:            { owner: "allow", assignedVendor: "allow", collaborator: "allow", otherOwner: "deny", unassignedVendor: "deny" },
  // ... one row per exported action in lib/actions/*.ts (44 total)
};

// for each action x actor: mock auth() to return the actor's session, call the action
// on a seeded record, then assert either success or "rejected AND row counts unchanged".
```
